findings: Upload metadata rides on x-* headers/query rather than multipart (deliberate per design D-1 to avoid adding @fastify/multipart; encapsulated application/octet-stream raw-body Buffer parser). Informational — a future client integrator should know metadata is not a multipart form.
revokedByUserId / createdByUserId / document_access_logs.versionId carry no FK (recorded-id/pointer precedent from prior phases, justified in the design). Informational, no action.

The behavioral suite signs every token with role: 'ADMIN'; this is safe only because authorization is resolved from DB membership in authenticate, not the token role claim. Informational — keep in mind if the token role claim ever gains authority.

headObject size/checksum integrity is re-verified only in the gated smoke test, not in the production upload path; acceptable because the server computes sha256+size from the exact received bytes before storing, making the persisted row authoritative. Informational, no action.
